people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,
translations.bsb: When Paul arrived, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing many serious charges that they could not prove.
translations.kjv: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.
translations.asv: And when he was come, the Jews that had come down from Jerusalem stood round about him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove;
